coverage_status_note: Sites located through their serving utilities and measured against the grid.
claims_absent_note: Measured from the grid up: every site located through the utility that actually serves it, then settled against nine years of federal meter data.

sites.note: confidence=medium. Vantage Data Centers owns and develops the 1200-acre 1.4 GW Frontier campus that OpenAI and Oracle occupy under Stargate. Vantage names no utility and cites only diverse power feeds, so serving utility is blank and the ERCOT weather zone is blank (the county sits between the WEST and NRTH zones). See the Oracle row for the same site: the fact sheet says it runs on an onsite gas microgrid.

confidence=medium. Project Jupiter, 1400 acres developed by BorderPlex Digital Assets with STACK Infrastructure, leased by Oracle with OpenAI the ultimate customer. MATERIAL CAVEAT: the source states the campus will run on a 700-900 MW gas microgrid that explicitly does NOT connect to El Paso Electric's grid, so this load will not appear in EPE demand.

confidence=medium. SoftBank's SB Energy builds, owns and operates the 1.2 GW Stargate site and OpenAI is the tenant; the source says it will be powered by new co-located utility-scale solar plus battery storage. No utility named. ERCOT weather zone left blank because Milam County sits on the NCEN/SCEN boundary.

confidence=low. The cited source confirms site prep on an AI data center at the former GM Lordstown plant bought by SoftBank, developed with OpenAI and Oracle. The cited source does NOT name a utility: Ohio Edison (PJM ATSI zone) is inferred from Trumbull County's service territory. All of Ohio is PJM so the BA is safe; the zone is the inferred part.

confidence=high. Vantage Data Centers owns and develops the roughly 1 GW four-building Lighthouse campus with OpenAI and Oracle as Stargate tenants; the release names We Energies supplying under a dedicated electricity rate with Vantage underwriting the power infrastructure.

confidence=high. SB Energy builds, owns and operates the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus on private and former federal land under a long-term lease to OpenAI; the release explicitly names AEP Ohio as partner alongside regional grid investment.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
Site mapping is hand-curated from serving utilities, never inferred from state.
Annual matched claims are TRUE under the GHG Protocol market-based method. The verdict is 'true on paper, X physically', not an accusation.
Measured from the grid up: every site located through the utility that actually serves it, then settled against nine years of federal meter data.
